title: Lateniiitez's lyricism shines in the release of his recent song "Naughty Gyal '' Feat. Prophez.
htmlContent:
American-based artist, Lateniiitez is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who is proving to the industry that he is, in fact, in his own musical and artistic lane. The talented artist Lateniiitez recently debuted a collaborative single titled "Naughty Gyal" with Prophez. As anticipated, the track gained successful momentum from his fans and the ears and attention of the industry. 

Lateniiitez's "Naughty Gyal" feat. Prophez is a song for all occasions. It's a vibe and is guaranteed to keep you upbeat. The music has a chill, funk sound that feels warm to the spirit and sets the perfect tone for the writing to flourish.

Listen to "Naughty Gyal" on Spotify below"
